title: Plans lock the contract and need a real dependency to split work
action: Make the planning and worker doctrine say what D1 and D2 of docs/history/agent-anti-patterns/CONTEXT.md lock. After this cell: a planner reading the Cell quality rules knows an action names the outcome and the contract and leaves internal structure to the worker; a planner reading expertise/planning.md knows expand-migrate-contract, phases and slices need a real dependency and meets the removal test; a worker reading the rendered cell prompt knows a simpler route that keeps every truth and prohibition is its call, recorded as a found-a-better-route departure; the goal-check text says it compares artifacts with must_haves and cited decisions, not with action wording. Where and how to word each edit is yours; keep each short and in the file's voice, and keep the existing expand-migrate-contract craft for the case where a real dependency exists. If the rendered-prompt golden test pins the old text, update only that expectation. Run bee dev regen and commit its outputs with the sources. A parallel worker (cell aap-2) edits packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/report_outcomes.rs in the same worktree: never stage, commit or revert it. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: aap-1`.
